page.layout: One block of text on the page, top left, below the digitiser's logos. Printed lines only: author, title, imprint, shelf mark, URN and VD17 number. The logos and rule above are the digitiser's and are left out.

main_text.l: Conclavia romana reserata sive mysterium iniquitatis in electione

page.notes: The digitiser's logos (BSB and MDZ) and the horizontal rule are not printed text and are left out. The author name is printed "Fueßli" in the scan; read as Fueßli (Fußli). The first letters of the scan line read "Fueßli", where the e may be a Cyrillic-like form; transcribed as Fueßli.
